purpose: Extend the fixed-chart physical Torch/JAX numerical-attachment comparison through the coarse-prefix NQC correction and full spliced waveform.
protocol: For each independently integrated coarse trajectory, apply its own fine-series NQC coefficients to every coarse mode sample, take samples strictly before the common restart index, then append the fine attached mode on the same local 0.5 M diagnostic chart. Check both correction values at the restart state, global times, zero support, prefix and complete complex relative L2.
interpretation: This checks cross-backend numerical parity on four selected scalar charts. The fine attachment is evaluated at 0.5 M, not at the production 0.015625 M output before downsampling. No independent physical reference, domain-wide convergence, full parameter gradient, or ROM qualification follows from a pass.
